result.stdout:
durable 0.5.0 - command-line tool for the Durable ORM

Usage: durable <command> [arguments] [options]

Migrations:
  migrate                Apply pending migrations from your assembly
  rollback               Revert applied migrations down to a target migration
  status                 Show applied and pending migrations
  script                 Generate a SQL script for migrations
  migrations add <Name>  Create a new migration class
  migrations list        Same as 'durable status'

Schema:
  schema diff            Show differences between entity types and the database
  schema sync            Bring the database schema up to date with the entity types
  scaffold               Generate entity classes from existing database tables

Other:
  help [command]         Show help for a command
  --version              Show the tool version

Settings: --provider (sqlite|postgres|mysql|sqlserver) and --connection select the database; they default to
the DURABLE_PROVIDER and DURABLE_CONNECTION environment variables, then to ./durable.json. Commands that
read your code build the project in the current directory (or --project) or load --assembly.

Run 'durable <command> --help' for the options of a command.
